posts.cooked:
I think it's an interesting idea, but Sentinels has a definite endpoint in the next year or so, and I don't think the videogame is going to catch up in time to overtake the card game.

 

Especially considering the extra effort it takes to program the cards for the videogame.

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Playtesting would be terrible on the app.  You'd have to program in every little adjustment in, and you have to figure out every little interaction ahead of time.  Especially for heros like Guise where you want to say "This card steals a thing.  We'll worry about how exactly he does it later"

 

Much easier on pen and paper, where vagueness is allowed, and adjustments can be made with a sharpie.
